metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for qa-e2e-pilot: full-stack, backend-baking, memory-persistent browser QA.

plugins.name: qa-e2e-pilot
plugins.description: Browser-driven end-to-end QA that verifies a feature's full stack, not just the screen: drives the UI, bakes (reads persisted state back at multiplicity 0/1/N), independently recomputes the feature's calculations and business rules against the spec oracle, probes the backend when the UI lies, and checkpoints a resumable memory trail.
